prompt:

Six items in exactly the same 3x2 arrangement: cream fridge, white robot vacuum, cream pet dispenser with coral bowl, white dome security camera, cream purifier, cream washer. NO redesign, no added or removed details, no resizing, no recentering, no spacing adjustment, no palette changes. No text. Only thinner navy boundary strokes, everything else held fixed.
